title: Kicked Crunchy Greek Cottage Cheese Saganaki
description: A creative twist on traditional Greek saganaki, featuring crispy fried cottage cheese, served in a banana leaf vessel. This dish is a perfect blend of flavors and textures, with a floral and aerated touch.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the cottage cheese, flour, cornstarch, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper until well combined.
Divide the mixture into 4 equal parts and shape each part into a small patty.
Dip each patty into the beaten eggs, coating completely, then roll in a plate of flour to coat.
Heat about 1/2 inch of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until it reaches 350 degrees Fahrenheit.

Double-fry the patties, first frying for 2-3 minutes on each side until lightly browned, then increasing the heat to 375 degrees Fahrenheit and frying for an additional 1-2 minutes on each side until crispy and golden brown.
Drain the fried patties on paper towels and place each one in the center of a banana leaf.
Fold the banana leaves over the patties to form a triangle or square shape, and secure with a toothpick if needed.
Serve the saganaki hot, garnished with a sprinkle of paprika and a dollop of low-fat yogurt or sour cream if desired.
Repeat the frying process in batches if necessary, to prevent overcrowding the skillet.
